annotations.title: Accrual and Cutoff by Service Period

description: Split invoices across a period end by their service dates for the month-end or year-end close. Send the last day of the period being closed (and optionally its first day), whether the invoices are expenses (supplier bills) or revenue (your own invoices), and each invoice's service start, service end and amount, with the invoice date if you have it. Get back, per invoice and in total, the days and the amount that belong before the period, in the period and after the period end (straight line by days), and, when the invoice date is given, the cutoff entry: an accrual for service up to the period end that is invoiced after it, or a prepaid / deferred amount for service after the period end that was invoiced by it. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/accrual-cutoff). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

amount.description: Invoice amount for the service (before tax); a credit note as a negative amount. Not 0.

invoice_date.description: Optional invoice date, YYYY-MM-DD; with it the cutoff entry is worked.

ref.description: Optional reference (an invoice number or supplier code, up to 6 digits in a row; your own text, echoed).

service_end.description: Last day of the service the invoice covers (same day or later), YYYY-MM-DD.

service_start.description: First day of the service the invoice covers, YYYY-MM-DD.

period_end.description: Last day of the period being closed, YYYY-MM-DD.

period_start.description: Optional first day of the period being closed; with it, service before the period is shown on its own.

side.description: expense (supplier bills: accrued expense / prepaid expense) or revenue (your invoices: accrued revenue / deferred revenue). Changes only the wording.
